alternative_chosen_by: most genome-only unique reads on non-selected sequence

coverage_semantics.genome_cov: genome route, reads with a top-score placement at the locus in the read-length window, at most one count per read at its P-site (cigar_aware). Only placements tied for the read's highest genomic score qualify; identical P-sites from several qualifying placements collapse to one count; disagreeing P-sites omit the read from position-resolved coverage (counted in genome_track_position_ambiguous_by_layer), never an arbitrary pick

layers.genome_cov_genome_only: genome_cov, NH==1, reads absent from the transcriptome BAM (partition: genome-only, unique)
layers.genome_cov_genome_only_multi: genome_cov, NH>1, reads absent from the transcriptome BAM (partition: genome-only, multimapping)
layers.genome_cov_shared_multi: genome_cov, NH>1, reads present in the transcriptome BAM (partition: shared, multimapping)
layers.genome_cov_shared_unique: genome_cov, NH==1, reads present in the transcriptome BAM (partition: shared, unique)
layers.stacking: GENOME_LAYERS / TXOME_LAYERS order, baseline first; each route's layers sum exactly to its track
layers.txome_cov_shared_multi: txome_cov, reads with a top-score genome placement at the locus and NH>1 (partition: shared, multimapping)
layers.txome_cov_shared_unique: txome_cov, reads with a top-score genome placement at the locus and NH==1 (partition: shared, unique)
layers.txome_cov_txome_only: txome_cov, reads with no top-score genome placement at the locus (partition: transcriptome-only at gene)

coverage_semantics.order: 5'->3' over the merged exons of both models (SplicedAxis order)
coverage_semantics.txome_cov: transcriptome route, every primary on the selected transcript (post-dedup BAM, RiboFlow_v2 MAPQ>=10), P-site projected through the transcript->genome map

txome_reads: every primary alignment in the post-dedup BAM (RiboFlow_v2 MAPQ>=10)
